stem.text: The potential difference $V$ across a filament lamp is slowly raised from zero to its normal operating value.
Which graph represents the variation with $V$ of the current $I$ in the lamp?

A.alt: Current against potential difference graph: a curve from the origin rising with decreasing gradient

B.alt: Current against potential difference graph: a straight line from the origin

C.alt: Current against potential difference graph: a curve starting at the top of the current axis and falling with decreasing gradient

D.alt: Current against potential difference graph: a curve from the origin rising with increasing gradient
